objective: Establish canonical coverage baseline across the repository with separation of backend/frontend, unit/branch/integration/E2E/generated, intentional exclusions.

infrastructure_findings.root_cause: coverage_measurement.py uses 'coverage report --format json' which is incompatible with coverage.py 7.x. The 'json' format key was removed in coverage 7.0; only 'json' is valid in coverage 5.x. This causes the verify.py measurement coverage command to ALWAYS FAIL on coverage 7.x regardless of actual coverage.
infrastructure_findings.implication: The canonical coverage measurement path is currently broken. Either pin coverage<7 or update the format key. Until fixed, manual measurement is required (as performed for this artifact).

honest_assessment.engines_alone_are_above_80: estimated based on per-file observations (engines/account_engine/*, reconciliation_engine, behaviour_engine, financial_intelligence all >=80%)
honest_assessment.the_80%_claim_from_state_a: FALSE at the repository-wide level. STATE A's '80.58% line coverage' was measured on a subset (likely C44 authoritative scope) NOT the entire src/ tree. The current aggregate measurement shows 69.45% across all src/.

test_type_separation.note: Only unit tests were executed under tests/unit. Other categories (contract, golden, properties, integration) were not measured by this run; they may exercise additional behavior but are not reflected in this number.
